observational_native: Only parent source games in signed intake_01..05 (10 maps both seats). Opponent orders only used for post-hoc action/outcome frequency, never for policy inputs or labels.
rule: Fresh planting only. Stage by joint decision t (0..50,51..250,251..298). Public clean opportunities reserve actually committed own hires and other planter payments; no other friendly committed landing, no current bases/trees; no adversary within one step, four visible neighboring soil cells, enough for purchase plus one minimum recruit.
training: Previously partitioned top5_h2h_data.json train maps only, evaluate val maps once. Exclude either name containing master3, case-insensitive. Ground truth is actual decision to hold/pay vs move at every clean opportunity. No weights from Master3s2. One small map-balanced logistic model, intercept and 13 public temporal/market context terms, fixed L2 .015, 300 full-batch iterations lr .5. Compare heldout Brier to map-balanced training-phase rate and pooled constant. Shape of stage deficit checked on 10 native training maps.
mid: Consider t=51..250 only if Sapling conditional hold/payment deficit appears in aggregate and more than five native maps; expert P(pay)>=0.5. Empirical support gate separately checks held purchases in this predicted half on >=5 maps, >=12 purchases, map-equal first-tenure net above zero, and majority map mean above zero. These do not identify the effect of changing MOVE to NONE on a whole match. As an additional protection on each intervention require a conservative provable lower bound on direct tree income; abstain for lack of one. No single-tree scholarly predicted ROI used as a decision label.
late: t>=251 requires Sapling conditional overplant on the same quorum; expert P(pay)<0.5. Only veto when direct income under the remaining official horizon provably cannot cover price. If necessary leave future mobility unspecified and use final-step before horizon (new trees earn no income that step). Veto direction must be collision-free, avoid enemy next-step reach and other committed own orders; preserved v1 forced autoregressive suffix must change only the focal planter. Maximum one executed override per match.
performance: A distinct proposal model only qualifies when heldout Brier beats training pooled constant and phase-only rates. Register real native support/actual issue counts per map and risk, do not play native matches or claim strength from these checks. If a direction lacks conversion deficit, predictive quality, defensible cash bound or actual trigger, abstain on that direction.
